title: Hints advance only on a changed answer
statement: Advance a hint ladder only when the answer has changed since the last try, so resubmitting the same answer cannot unlock more help.
example: One inference design asks an unchanged answer to try again and reveals the full words only on the third failed try.
detail: A Grade 3 inference design gives its typed sentence frame a feedback ladder that advances only if the answer has changed since the last try. An empty or unchanged answer is only asked to have another go, and the full words are revealed on the third fail.
